title: Executive Assistant To CEO (UK- Property Management)
jobDescription:
Executive Assistant to Managing Director - Operations & Project

Coordination


Location: Remote India

Type: Full-time
Salary: 50000 to 65000 per month ( for outstanding candidates can be higher than this )
Progression: Significant opportunity to develop into broader operational responsibilities as the group continues to grow


About the Company : We are a UK-based group of companies operating across:


  • Residential architecture
  • Structural engineering
  • Residential property management

Over the last few years, the group has grown to a team of more than 25 people, with most of our operational team working remotely from India.We place a strong emphasis on:


  • Clear systems and processes
  • Accountability
  • Operational efficiency
  • Automation
  • AI
  • Modern technology
  • Taking responsibility for outcomes rather than simply completing individual actions
  • Our team uses platforms including ChatGPT, Claude, Trello, TeamGantt, Fireflies, Microsoft 365 and other integrated business systems.

As the group continues to grow, we are looking for an exceptionally capable Executive Assistant to work directly with the Managing Director and take responsibility for a wide range of administrative, operational and coordination tasks.


The Role


This is not simply a diary-management Executive Assistant position. We are looking for someone who can become the Managing Director's highly capable right hand. The role combines:


  • Executive assistance
  • Business administration
  • Task ownership
  • Basic project coordination
  • Follow-up and accountability
  • AI-assisted work
  • Basic property portfolio management
  • General operational support

A major part of your job will be taking tasks away from the Managing Director and making sure they actually get completed.


You may need to coordinate several other employees in order to achieve this.For example, you may be given an objective that requires input from accounts, IT and another department.


Your responsibility is not simply to send everyone an email.Your responsibility is to coordinate the actions, follow up where necessary, identify problems and ensure the required outcome is achieved.


We are looking for someone who understands the difference between:

I sent the reminder. and The task was completed.That distinction is extremely important to us.


1. Executive Support: You will help manage the Managing Director's day-to-day business workload. This may include:


  • Managing and organizing the calendar
  • Arranging meetings
  • Preparing information before meetings
  • Following up actions after meetings
  • Drafting emails and correspondence
  • Organising documents and information
  • Researching issues
  • Keeping track of commitments
  • Managing reminders and deadlines
  • Making appointments
  • Obtaining information from other employees
  • Dealing with routine matters without unnecessary escalation
  • Filtering administrative issues before they reach the Managing Director

The objective is to reduce the number of routine matters requiring Managing Director involvement.Where something can reasonably be handled by you, we expect you to take ownership of it.


2. Task Ownership and Follow-ThroughThis is one of the most important parts of the position.The Managing Director will regularly give you tasks or outcomes to achieve.Sometimes these will have clearly defined steps.Other times you may simply be told:Can you sort this out?You should be capable of:


  • Understanding what the required outcome is
  • Working out what needs to happen
  • Identifying who needs to be involved
  • Allocating or requesting actions from colleagues
  • Setting or confirming deadlines
  • Following up outstanding work
  • Checking that information has been received
  • Resolving straightforward problems
  • Identifying when something is going off track
  • Escalating genuinely important issues
  • Confirming that the final outcome has actually been achieved

We do not want someone who considers their responsibility complete simply because they have sent an email or reminder.We want someone who takes responsibility for getting the task over the finish line.


3. Project and Team CoordinationThe role includes basic project coordination.You do not need to be a professionally trained Project Manager and we are not looking for someone focused on complex project-management methodology.However, you should be comfortable coordinating tasks between several people.For example, the Managing Director may decide that the company needs to introduce a new process.You may then need to:


  • Identify the actions required
  • Work out which employees need to be involved
  • Create a simple action plan
  • Coordinate different team members
  • Keep track of deadlines
  • Follow up outstanding tasks
  • Identify delays
  • Make sure dependencies are dealt with
  • Keep the Managing Director informed where necessary
  • Confirm that the new process has actually been implemented

You should be capable of taking something from: Objective Actions Owners Follow-Up Completion Previous experience with project coordination would therefore be useful.


4. AI and Technology Strong practical AI skills are a core requirement for this role. We believe that a modern Executive Assistant should be capable of using AI to dramatically improve their productivity. You should already use, or be highly comfortable using, tools such as ChatGPT and Claude in your normal working life. You may use AI to help with:


  • Research
  • Drafting emails
  • Summarizing meetings
  • Analyzing transcripts
  • Organizing information
  • Comparing documents
  • Preparing reports
  • Creating checklists
  • Drafting procedures
  • Structuring unclear information
  • Researching unfamiliar subjects
  • Preparing meeting notes
  • Solving administrative problems
  • Improving existing processes

You do not need to be a programmer or AI engineer. However, candidates who have little practical experience with AI and little interest in becoming highly proficient with it are unlikely to be suitable. Equally, we do not want someone who blindly copies and pastes AI-generated answers. You must be capable of:


  • Giving AI clear instructions
  • Providing appropriate context
  • Reviewing outputs critically
  • Spotting mistakes
  • Improving the result
  • Using your own judgement

AI should make you more capable it should not replace your judgement.


5. Basic Property Portfolio Management: One of the companies within the group, CEB Properties, operates a very small UK residential property portfolio of approximately six properties.Part of your role will involve handling its routine day-to-day administration.


This is not a specialist property-management position, and the portfolio is deliberately small.


The company is building clear operating systems, workflows, checklists and procedures to make these tasks straightforward to manage.

Typical responsibilities may include:


  • Responding to routine tenant communication
  • Coordinating property viewings
  • Arranging maintenance
  • Contacting contractors
  • Following up repairs
  • Coordinating check-ins and check-outs
  • Organising referencing
  • Managing routine tenancy administration
  • Keeping property records organised
  • Monitoring safety and compliance deadlines
  • Arranging periodic inspections
  • Making sure routine property tasks are completed

Previous property-management or real-estate experience would be an advantage because you will already understand some of these processes. However, it is not essential


A capable and organized person should be able to learn this part of the role quickly using the systems provided.


6. Business Administration : You will take responsibility for a variety of routine business-administration tasks across the group.This may include:

  • Insurance renewals
  • Insurance claims administration
  • Obtaining quotations
  • Managing subscriptions
  • Supplier accounts
  • Routine business registrations
  • Organising company records
  • Renewing services
  • Basic purchasing
  • Booking appointments
  • Researching suppliers or services
  • Filling in forms
  • Following up third parties
  • Organising documents
  • Maintaining records
  • Updating trackers
  • Managing routine correspondence
  • Checking that recurring administrative tasks have been completed

We need someone who does not consider ordinary administrative work beneath them. At the same time, we want you to continually look for ways to make repetitive work easier.


You should naturally ask:


Can this be simplified?

Can AI help with this?

Can this be automated?

Can we create a template?

Can we create a checklist so we don't have to rethink this next time?


7. Follow-Up and Accountability Across the Team: Because we have a team of more than 20 people, the Managing Director cannot personally follow up every outstanding action. You will help create accountability. his may involve:


  • Following up department heads
  • Following up individual team members
  • Requesting updates
  • Checking deadlines
  • Identifying overdue actions
  • Confirming whether tasks have actually been completed
  • Organising information from several people
  • Highlighting problems
  • Escalating matters when genuinely necessary

You must therefore be comfortable politely but persistently following up colleagues, including people who may be more senior than you within their own department.


We are looking for somebody who is pleasant and professional but persistent.


8. Process Improvement: You do not need to be an operations Manager. However, we want someone who naturally likes organized ways of working. As you become familiar with the business, you may help:


  • Improve checklists
  • Create templates
  • Document recurring tasks
  • Improve simple procedures
  • Organise filing systems
  • Identify unnecessary administration
  • Improve trackers
  • Identify repetitive work that could be automated
  • Use AI to improve routine processes

The Managing Director and Operations team will develop many of the larger operating systems.


Your job will often be to work effectively within those systems and help improve them through practical experience.

The Person We Are Looking For


We are looking for someone who is:


  • Extremely organised
  • Highly proactive
  • Intelligent and quick to learn
  • Dependable
  • Persistent
  • Detail-oriented
  • Comfortable working independently
  • Comfortable coordinating other employees
  • Capable of managing several tasks simultaneously
  • Strong at following work through to completion
  • Confident communicating with department heads
  • Excellent in written and spoken English
  • Technically confident
  • Comfortable learning new software
  • Already comfortable using AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude
  • Capable of researching unfamiliar subjects
  • Able to use common sense and judgement
  • Solutions-focused
  • Discreet and trustworthy
  • Comfortable carrying out basic administrative work

Most importantly, you should have a strong sense of ownership.

If you are given responsibility for something, we want you to think:I am responsible for making sure this gets done.Particularly

Relevant Experience


We would be particularly interested in candidates who have previously worked as:


  • Executive Assistant
  • Executive Assistant to Founder / CEO / Managing Director
  • Senior Executive Assistant
  • Founders Office Associate
  • Business Operations Associate
  • Operations Executive
  • Business Support Executive
  • Executive Operations Associate
  • Administrative Manager

Experience involving any of the following would also be particularly valuable:


  • Project coordination
  • Property management
  • Real estate
  • Business operations
  • Working with multiple departments
  • Process improvement
  • Startup or SME environments
  • Working directly with a founder or Managing Director
  • AI and automation

You do not need experience in every area. We are more interested in intelligence, ownership, organization, judgement and ability to learn quickly than in finding somebody whose previous job description exactly matches ours.


This Role Is Probably Not Right for You If

This position is unlikely to suit you if:


  • You require detailed instructions for every task
  • You are uncomfortable making straightforward decisions
  • You dislike chasing people for outstanding actions
  • You consider a task complete simply because you sent a reminder
  • You dislike basic administrative work
  • You prefer very narrowly defined responsibilities
  • You struggle to manage several different types of work
  • You are uncomfortable learning new technology
  • You rarely use AI and have little interest in becoming proficient with it
  • You regularly escalate straightforward problems rather than trying to solve them

What Success Looks Like


Within your first six months, we would expect you to have:


  • Taken control of a substantial amount of the Managing Director's routine administration
  • Reduced unnecessary interruptions to the Managing Director
  • Created a reliable system for managing follow-ups and outstanding actions
  • Successfully coordinated multiple tasks involving different employees
  • Taken responsibility for routine administration within the small property portfolio
  • Become confident managing its approximately six properties
  • Taken responsibility for routine business administration such as insurance, suppliers and renewals
  • Become highly proficient with the company's AI tools
  • Improved the organisation of important information and records
  • Assisted with several internal projects
  • Improved or documented recurring administrative processes
  • Demonstrated that when you are given an outcome to achieve, you can take responsibility for getting it completed

Development and Progression: This role has significant scope to develop.


As you become more capable and understand the business, you may progressively take responsibility for:


  • More complex internal projects
  • Wider operational coordination
  • Property operations
  • Business processes
  • Automation initiatives
  • Junior administrative support
  • Cross-departmental initiatives

We are a growing business and are looking for someone who wants to become a highly trusted and capable member of the management support team.


Application


Shortlisted candidates will be assessed primarily on practical capability rather than CV length or impressive job titles.

We are particularly interested in evidence of:


  • Strong practical AI use
  • Exceptional organisation
  • Task ownership
  • Follow-through
  • Problem solving
  • Basic project coordination
  • Clear written communication
  • Good business judgement
  • The ability to take an objective and get it completed

jobDescription:
We are hiring an Operations & Events Executive to help run the day-to-day of an established organisation in the international education sector, and to own the delivery of its events.


This is a hands-on ownership role. We run a calendar of programmes, awards, summits, roundtables and student events across India and the UK, we work with a large number of universities, and we have a community of members and volunteers spread across the country. Much of it currently depends on personal effort and individual follow-up, and this role exists to turn that into an operation that runs to a system, and to deliver the set-piece events to a real standard.


This is a fully remote role. We are open to candidates from anywhere.


Working hours Monday to Friday: 9am to 6pm UK time.

Saturday: 9am to 1:30pm UK time.


The Role: AI-native, used centrally throughout


You will:

  • Help own the operating calendar across every programme and event
  • Be part of the team day to day: set the rhythm, run the check-ins, hold people to a standard
  • Help own the set-piece events end to end: planning, suppliers, venues, budgets, run sheets, and the delivery itself, directing the on-ground coordinators and volunteers who deliver in person.
  • Coordinate volunteer and ambassador network that delivers much of what happens
  • Keep every workstream moving, projects, partnerships, events and community, and always be able to say what is on track, what is at risk, and what needs a decision.
  • Turn recurring work into process: SOPs, trackers and tooling, so the second run takes half the effort of the first.
  • Help own budgets and spend across operations and events: what was approved, what was spent, and why they differ.
  • Manage suppliers and contracts, and hold them to what they agreed.
  • Report upwards clearly and without being asked, and take work and decisions off the leadership as trust builds.
  • Use AI across your workflow: planning, drafting, tracking, reporting, automation and beyond.

What we're looking for

  • Experience across operations, programme management and event delivery
  • Proven event delivery: you have personally helped produced significant events end to end, including run sheets.
  • Able to deliver at a distance, through people on the ground, without losing control of the detail.
  • Highly organised in practice, not in description: nothing dropped, everything tracked, follow-up without a reminder.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and with building the structure yourself. There is no finished playbook.
  • The ceiling and the appetite to grow into running the whole operation.
  • Excellent written and spoken English. Much of the coordination is written, and much of it is with senior people.
  • Genuine, demonstrable fluency with AI tools as part of how you work, with concrete examples.

B. AI and Advanced Analytics (Mandatory)

jobDescription:
About Zenara

Zenara is building technology to enable a new way to practise psychiatry: whole-person, continuous and psychiatrist-led care.

Our products help psychiatric practices understand patients more deeply before visits, capture more useful signal between visits, and support more consistent ongoing care - while keeping the psychiatrist firmly at the centre of clinical decision-making.

We are a growing, distributed company with team members working across India and other international markets. We are expanding the team, and we need a highly organised and trusted person to strengthen our recruitment, people-operations and executive-administration capabilities.

About the role

You will support our founders and leadership team across four connected areas: recruitment coordination, HR and people administration, timesheet and payroll administration, and confidential executive support.

This is a hands-on, execution-focused role. You will keep processes moving, maintain accurate records, communicate clearly with candidates and colleagues, and make sure agreed tasks are completed reliably and on time.

To be clear about the level: this is not a senior HR strategy or employment-law role. We are looking for someone practical, highly organised, discreet, and capable of independently running routine people and administrative workflows without being chased.

You will have access to sensitive information - employee records, compensation details, candidate information, company plans and leadership discussions. Trust, discretion and sound judgement are essential parts of the job, not add-ons to it.

What you will own 1. Recruitment coordination
  • Maintain the recruitment pipeline across multiple open positions
  • Keep Workable, Linear and other recruitment trackers accurate and up to date
  • Review incoming applications against agreed role requirements
  • Organise and prioritise candidates for review
  • Coordinate first-round screening and interviews
  • Communicate with candidates throughout the process
  • Schedule interviews across India, US and other relevant time zones
  • Send interview instructions, reminders and follow-ups
  • Track candidate completion of screening, interviews and assessments
  • Coordinate background and reference checks where required
  • Prepare candidate information for interviewers
  • Maintain accurate records of interview outcomes and next steps
  • Make sure candidates are followed up promptly and professionally
  • Support offer, pre-boarding and onboarding administration
  • Help improve our recruitment workflows and systems as we scale

We are building technology-supported recruitment workflows, including automated candidate screening, interview processes, ranking and follow-up. You will help operate, monitor and improve those workflows rather than relying only on manual administration.

2. HR and people administration
  • Maintain accurate employee records and HR documentation
  • Support employee onboarding and offboarding
  • Coordinate collection of required employee information and documents
  • Track leave, attendance and other routine people-administration matters
  • Maintain records of probation periods, review dates and employment milestones
  • Prepare standard HR letters, documents and internal records
  • Support the administration of employment agreements
  • Make sure routine HR processes are completed consistently and on time
  • Respond to straightforward employee administration questions
  • Escalate sensitive or complex employee matters to the founders
  • Keep HR files organised, accurate and accessible

This role provides HR administration and coordination. You will not be expected to provide independent legal, employment-law or senior employee-relations advice.

3. Timesheets and payroll administration
  • Collect and monitor employee timesheets
  • Follow up on missing or incomplete submissions
  • Maintain accurate records for payroll processing
  • Prepare payroll inputs for review and submission
  • Coordinate with payroll providers, accountants and other relevant parties
  • Track payroll-related questions and issues
  • Maintain records of approved payments and payroll documentation

You will not own payroll, compensation or employment-policy decisions. Your responsibility is to make sure the administrative process is accurate, organised and completed on time.

4. Executive assistance
  • Provide trusted administrative support to our two co-founders
  • Manage and coordinate calendars and meetings
  • Schedule internal and external meetings
  • Prepare agendas, action lists and follow-up trackers
  • Record or organise meeting actions where required
  • Follow up with team members on agreed actions
  • Coordinate travel arrangements and related logistics
  • Organise documents and information for leadership discussions
  • Assist with practical administrative tasks and research
  • Support occasional projects that need careful coordination and follow-through

This will include practical, get-it-done administrative work. You should be comfortable handling a broad range of tasks without losing sight of priorities.

5. Confidentiality and information management
  • Treat employee, candidate, compensation and company information as strictly confidential
  • Store and share sensitive information only through approved systems
  • Use sound judgement about who should have access to what
  • Maintain professional boundaries with colleagues
  • Avoid informal discussion of confidential matters
  • Escalate any suspected confidentiality or data-security issue immediately

You will be part of the trusted leadership-support function. You should be comfortable working openly and warmly with the wider team while understanding that some information simply must not be shared.

Your first 60 days
  • Understand our current recruitment and HR workflows
  • Review and organise existing employee and candidate records
  • Get familiar with Workable, Linear and our other systems
  • Take ownership of recruitment coordination for the roles we have open
  • Establish a reliable process for interview scheduling and candidate follow-up
  • Take over timesheet and payroll administration
  • Document recurring HR and executive-administration processes
  • Establish a regular reporting rhythm with the founders
  • Identify administrative gaps, duplication or unnecessary manual work
What success looks like
  • Recruitment pipelines stay accurate and current
  • Candidates receive timely, professional communication
  • Interviews are scheduled efficiently and follow-ups are never missed
  • Recruitment workflows are consistently operated and steadily improved
  • Employee records and HR documents are complete and organised
  • Timesheet and payroll administration is accurate and on time
  • Routine HR questions and administrative requests are handled without escalation
  • The founders spend materially less time on scheduling, follow-up and administrative coordination
  • Sensitive information is handled with complete discretion
  • The company has a more reliable and scalable people-operations process
Requirements Required
  • Previous experience in HR administration, recruitment coordination, executive assistance, office administration or people operations
  • Experience coordinating several tasks, candidates or workflows at the same time

title: Associate Lead
jobDescription:
Job Purpose
As an AI Engineer in Data Intelligence Unit, you will help build and operate the core building blocks of Data Representation learning and Context Engineering across the credit Risk, Fraud/FRM, Sales, Collections Recovery. You will work with senior engineers and Data scientists to converts raw structured and unstructured data into reliable features, embeddings, retrieval-ready knowledge assets, and repeatable evaluation pipelines so downstream AI pods can ship models faster, safer, and with measurable quality.
Duties and Responsibilities
1) Data Representation Pipelines

Prepare and validate datasets from multiple sources (transactions, bureau, device/digital, documents,

CRM/operations)


Implement features engineering pipelines (aggregations, ratios, behavior signals) and maintain feature

definitions.


Build large-scale ML systems: distributed training pipelines, feature stores, model registry, CI/CD for ML, and

scalable batch + near-real-time scoring services.


Support embedding workflows (text/customer/device/dealer/geo) including batch refresh, versioning, and

lineage.


2) Knowledge Engineering Support (Canonical Objects Metadata Assets)

Help create/maintain canonical objects, entity dictionaries, taxonomies/ontologies, and labeling guidelines.

Support annotation/labeling workflows (quality checks, consistency, sampling) for training and evaluation.


3) Experimentation Model Operations

Execute training/inference jobs using established frameworks, log experiments and outcomes.

Perform error analysis, data leakage checks, and basic model monitoring (drift signals, data anomalies)

Contribute to deployment readiness: tests, reproducible configs, and incident triage support.


4) Retrieval Context Engineering Support (LLM/RAG enablement)

Assist document processing: chunking, cleaning, metadata tagging, indexing access filters.

Maintain prompt/context templates, grounding rules, and evaluation sets for RAG/LLM assistants used by

Pods.

Run offline evaluations (retrieval quality, answer quality, regressions) and track metrics across releases.

5) Engineering Hygiene Governance

Write clean, testable code; follow Git workflows and CI checks.

Maintain documentation: dataset cards, feature notes, pipeline SOPs, and release checklists.

Follow security/privacy controls for regulated data, ensuring traceability and auditability.
Required Qualifications and Experience
Basic Qualifications:

Bachelors/Masters in CS/Math/Engineering

0 2 yearsexperience in Data Science /Applied ML/ ML Engineering with proven leadership delivering

production grade ML system at scale.



Required Skills Competencies Core (must-have) Programming: Python (strong), SQL (strong); Git; basic unit testing. Data: Pandas/PySpark basics, joins/aggregations/window functions, data validation and profiling. ML Fundamentals: supervised/unsupervised learning, embeddings, train/val/test discipline, metrics, and error analysis. Applied System Mindset: reproducibility, structured debugging, logging/monitoring fundamentals. Good-to-have Skills ML frameworks: Pytorch / TensorFlow; experiment tracking (MLFlow) Retrieval stack: vector indexing concepts, chunking strategies, hybrid search ideas, evaluation datasets. Data/Infra: Airflow/Prefect, Spark, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, MongoDB, feature stores, graph Database, vector database, model serving basics. Preferred Qualifications Experience building end-to-end decisioning platforms with real-time and batch orchestration. Graph ML / entity-resolution experience for relationship-based risk and fraud analysis. Experience operating ML systems across multiple products/segments with multi-tenant controls. Publications/patents or strong track record of innovation in applied ML, large-scale ML systems

Preferred Qualifications

What Youll Work On
  • Intelligent autonomous agents

  • AI-powered engineering workflows

jobDescription:
About the Role

  • We are looking for a visionary AI Video Artist who is not just a prompter, but a true technical creator.
  • You sit at the intersection of Visual Effects (VFX), Game Engines, and Generative AI.
  • You will be responsible for creating hyper-realistic, cinematic video content by blending traditional compositing tools with state-of-the-art AI platforms.
  • We don't just want "AI videos"we want production-grade realism.
  • You must understand lighting, camera movement, and consistency, using AI as a power tool to accelerate high-end workflows.

Key Responsibilities

  • End-to-End Creation: Conceptualize and produce high-fidelity video content using a hybrid workflow of AI generation and manual VFX polishing.
  • Advanced AI Prompting: Utilize tools like Runway (Gen-3), Kling, Midjourney, and Sora/Veo to generate base assets with precise camera control and character consistency.
  • VFX & Compositing: Take AI-generated raw footage and refine it using After Effects, Nuke, or DaVinci Resolve.
  • Fix artifacts, handle color grading, and ensure temporal stability (no "flickering").
  • 3D & Gaming Integration: Work with Unreal Engine 5 or Blender to create realistic environments and integrate digital avatars if required.
  • Character Consistency: Train or fine-tune models (LoRAs/ControlNet) to ensure characters look exactly the same across different shots and angles.
  • R&D: Stay updated daily on the newest AI tools.
  • If a new model drops on Hugging Face or GitHub, you should be the first to test it.

Required Skills & Toolset 1.

  • The "Real" Tech Stack (Non-Negotiable): VFX/Editing: Mastery of Adobe After Effects (Compositing, Roto), Premiere Pro, and DaVinci Resolve (Color Grading).
  • 3D Basics: Familiarity with Blender or Unreal Engine (Camera setting, Lighting, Environment design).
  • The AI Stack (Deep Knowledge Required): Video Gen: Runway Gen-3 Alpha, Kling AI, Luma Dream Machine, or Haiper.
  • Image Gen: Midjourney v6 (Advanced Parameters), Stable Diffusion (ComfyUI workflows are a huge plus).
  • Lip-Sync & Voice: ElevenLabs, HeyGen, or LivePortrait.
  • Optimization: Topaz Video AI (Upscaling) and interpolation tools.
  • Soft Skills: "Director's Eye": You understand cinematographyfocal lengths, shutter angles, lighting setups (Rim light, Key light), and composition.
  • Problem Solving: AI makes mistakes.
  • You must know how to fix "weird hands" or "glitchy eyes" manually in post-production.

Nice-to-Have (Bonus Points)

  • Experience in the Gaming Industry (Level Design, Cinematics, or Character Rigging).
  • Knowledge of ComfyUI Node systems for complex Stable Diffusion workflows.
  • Experience with Python scripting for automating media workflows.
  • Background in traditional art or photography.
  • Who You Are You don't just type "Make a cool video" into ChatGPT.
  • You write detailed prompts like "Cinematic wide shot, 35mm lens, volumetric lighting, cyberpunk street, unreal engine 5 render style --ar 16:9".
  • You are frustrated when AI video looks "wobbly" and you know exactly how to stabilize it.
  • You have an open mindset: You are willing to relearn your workflow every month as technology changes.
  • Submission Requirement Please do not send just a CV.
  • You must share a Portfolio or Showreel demonstrating: AI-Generated Video work (mentioning the tools used).
  • Any VFX breakdowns (Before/After) showing how you fixed/improved raw AI output.

  • Hands-on experience with N-tier visibility tools and scenario simulation

OR

  • Ability to gather business requirements, identify platform fits and gaps, and develop functional specifications for traceability and sustainability reporting use cases
  • Ability to interpret complex, multi-source data sets and map data elements across systems, value chain steps, and stakeholders

OR

AI Integration, Automation & Innovation Lead


Job Type: Full-Time
Position: AI Integration, Automation & Innovation Lead
Industry: Education & Technology
Contract: Temporary/ Contractual


About the Role

We are looking for an ambitious, highly motivated and forward-thinking AI Integration, Automation & Innovation Lead to take ownership of the research, development, implementation and integration of Artificial Intelligence across our organisation.

This is not simply an IT support or ChatGPT-based role. We are looking for someone who is genuinely passionate about AI, automation and emerging technology and wants to become deeply involved in helping us build an AI-enabled organisation.

You will work closely with senior management, learn how different areas of the company operate, identify opportunities for improvement and develop practical AI and automation solutions that improve efficiency, education, administration, marketing, customer experience and overall business performance.


The role combines AI research, development, automation, integration, dashboard creation, data visualisation, experimentation, implementation, training and strategic thinking.


Key Responsibilities

You will be responsible for:

  • Researching new and emerging AI technologies, platforms and models.
  • Identifying opportunities to use AI and automation throughout the organisation.
  • Developing and implementing AI-powered workflows and business processes.
  • Automating repetitive and time-consuming administrative tasks.
  • Integrating AI with existing company software, websites, databases and platforms.
  • Building AI assistants, copilots, agents and agentic workflows.
  • Developing autonomous and semi-autonomous AI processes with appropriate human oversight.
  • Developing API, webhook and third-party software integrations.
  • Exploring Model Context Protocol (MCP) and emerging AI interoperability standards.
  • Developing internal AI tools, applications and dashboards.
  • Designing and building professional, interactive dashboards for management and different areas of the organisation.
  • Creating real-time and automated dashboards that bring together information from multiple systems and data sources.
  • Developing KPI, student-performance, operational, financial, marketing, CRM, sales and management dashboards.
  • Using AI within dashboards to analyse data, identify trends, highlight risks and opportunities, and generate actionable insights.
  • Developing AI-powered reporting and natural-language analytics, allowing authorised users to ask questions about company data and receive reports, summaries, charts and insights.
  • Exploring AI-assisted software development and coding agents.
  • Developing AI-powered knowledge bases and internal search systems.
  • Implementing RAG, semantic search, embeddings, vector databases and knowledge-management solutions.
  • Exploring AI-powered document processing and information extraction.
  • Developing AI-assisted data analysis, reporting and business intelligence.
  • Exploring predictive analytics and decision-support systems.
  • Supporting AI integration within CRM, customer service, admissions and communication systems.
  • Developing marketing, content and social-media automations.
  • Exploring AI-powered voice, telephone and conversational systems.
  • Exploring AI-generated images, audio, video, avatars and multimedia.
  • Investigating computer-use agents capable of interacting with browsers and software.
  • Exploring multimodal AI capable of understanding text, images, documents, audio and video.
  • Evaluating open-source, cloud-based, local and private AI models.
  • Exploring model customisation, fine-tuning and domain-specific AI where appropriate.
  • Monitoring the accuracy, reliability and performance of AI systems.
  • Developing AI evaluation and quality-assurance processes.
  • Maintaining appropriate human review for important AI-generated outputs.
  • Evaluating AI costs, subscriptions, API usage and return on investment.
  • Supporting AI security, privacy, GDPR, safeguarding and governance requirements.
  • Training staff in the effective and responsible use of AI.
  • Creating internal AI procedures, documentation and best-practice guidelines.
  • Monitoring developments within the global AI industry and recommending technologies the organisation should investigate.
  • Developing and maintaining a longer-term AI Transformation Roadmap for the organisation.

You are not expected to be an expert in every area.

What matters is your ability to learn rapidly, investigate unfamiliar technologies, experiment intelligently and turn promising ideas into practical solutions.


AI in Education

As an education organisation, a major part of our AI strategy will involve exploring how technology can improve teaching and learning.


Projects may include:

  • Intelligent question generation

We do not want somebody who is dependent upon one particular AI provider.


The successful candidate should be able to compare technologies and select the most appropriate solution for each business requirement.

The Person We Are Looking For

We are particularly interested in somebody who is:

  • Passionate about AI and emerging technology.
  • Extremely curious and willing to learn.
  • Self-motivated.
  • Technically confident.
  • Innovative and creative.
  • Highly organised.

  • Prepared to challenge inefficient processes.
  • Persistent when solving difficult problems.
  • Focused on practical outcomes rather than technology for technology's sake.
  • Excited by the rapid development of AI.

Most importantly, you must genuinely enjoy learning.

AI is developing too quickly for anyone to rely solely on what they already know.

Take Ownership

We are not looking for somebody who simply waits to be given individual tasks.

We want somebody whose approach is:

Explore Identify Research Design Build Test Validate Implement Measure Improve

You should be willing to examine an existing process and ask:

"Is there a better way of doing this, and can AI or automation help us achieve it?"

You will be encouraged to research technologies, propose ideas, build prototypes, test solutions and take successful projects through to implementation.

Full-Time Commitment

This is a full-time role requiring significant commitment and engagement with the organisation during and alongside our normal company operating hours.

We are looking for someone who wants to become an integral and long-term part of the organisation rather than simply providing occasional AI consultancy.

The successful candidate will be expected to continually learn and develop as AI technology evolves.


Learning & Career Development

This position offers significant scope for professional development.

You will have opportunities to:

  • Research emerging AI technologies.
  • Experiment with new platforms.

  • Build a substantial portfolio of practical AI implementations.
  • Progress as the organisation's AI capabilities expand.

For the right individual, the position has the potential to develop into a senior role with responsibility for the organisation's wider AI strategy, automation, business intelligence and digital transformation.


What Success Looks Like

Initially, you will learn how our organisation operates and identify opportunities where AI and automation can make an immediate difference.


You will then help develop an AI Transformation Roadmap, covering:

  • Immediate opportunities and quick wins
  • Automation opportunities

Business Impact Feasibility Cost Risk Scalability

Reduce Administration Increase Productivity Improve Quality Personalise Learning Improve Customer Experience Improve Decision-Making Improve Data Visibility Reduce Costs Develop New Capabilities Create New Opportunities

"If you were given responsibility for transforming our organisation through AI, what are the first three areas you would investigate, and why?"

The Trust and Safety (Content Moderation and Responsible AI) offering(s) within Accenture helps keep the internet safe and helps platform companies accelerate, scale, and improve their businesses. Accentures Trust Safety team, serves as an important line of defense by helping improve the quality and safety of online content while gaining hands-on job experience. You will deliver value to our clients, while making a larger impact on society. You will be responsible for analyzing and reviewing user profiles, audio, videos, and text-based content and/or investigating, escalating and/or resolving issues that are reported by users or flagged by the system. Therefore, Trust Safety resources need strong resilience and coping skills. We care for the health and well-being of our people and provide the support and resources needed to perform their role responsibilities. This role requires active participation in Accentures well-being support program, designed specifically for the Trust Safety community, provides valuable skills to promote individual and collective well-being.

  • Please note that this role may require you to work in rotational shifts
  • Review, classify and/or remove, work with, view, or proactively engage with content according to client guidelines, using specific tools and channels

jobDescription:
Job Summary

Analytics Engineer II

This role will need hands-on technical role responsible for supporting and enhancing business-critical platforms through data-driven engineering, automation, and operational excellence.

The role combines analytics engineering with L3 production support, data transformation, automation, and operational ownership of business-critical treasury data flows.

The position works closely with engineering, product, and business stakeholders in a globally distributed environment, with a strong focus on treasury systems, financial data flows, analytics-ready datasets, and SQL-based data solutions.

Our platform ensures funds are available for trading and operational payments, connected with key trading systems like Aladdin and Apex. It also works with our Financial Messaging Hub to send payments and receive bank balances.

Youll be part of a global, collaborative team working closely with business and engineering partners to keep these critical systems running smoothly and continuously improving them.

The team follows Agile and DevOps practices and is actively transitioning toward a cloud-first architecture (Microsoft Azure).

jobDescription:
Digital Marketing Specialist Social Media & Performance Marketing

Location: Ranchi, Jharkhand
Job Type: Full-Time
Work Mode: On-site

We are looking for a Digital Marketing Specialist who understands that digital marketing is not just about posting content, boosting posts, or increasing followers.

We need someone who understands why people stop, watch, engage, enquire and eventually become customers.

Your job will be to combine Content + Consumer Psychology + Data + Paid Advertising to grow our social media presence and generate quality leads.

What You'll Be Responsible For

  • Build and execute our Instagram, Facebook and YouTube growth strategy
  • Plan content calendars with the creative team
  • Identify content topics based on audience interests, search behaviour and market trends
  • Work closely with videographers, editors and content creators
  • Analyse which Reels/videos are performing and why
  • Improve hooks, thumbnails, captions, CTAs and content positioning
  • Run and optimize Meta Ads & Google Ads
  • Create lead-generation and remarketing campaigns
  • Track leads from Ad Landing Page/WhatsApp Enquiry Conversion
  • Conduct A/B tests on creatives, audiences, hooks and offers
  • Build retargeting audiences
  • Monitor campaign performance and optimize budgets
  • Prepare simple weekly/monthly performance reports

The Skills We're Looking For

1. Social Media Strategy

You should understand:

  • Instagram Reels
  • Facebook
  • YouTube & YouTube Shorts
  • Organic content growth
  • Content distribution
  • Audience building
  • Engagement & retention
  • Social-media trends
  • Competitor research

You shouldn't simply tell us:

“This Reel got 50,000 views.”

You should be able to explain:

“Why did it get 50,000 views, where did viewers drop, what made people share it, and how can we repeat that success?”

2. Performance Marketing

Hands-on experience with:

  • Meta Ads Manager
  • Facebook & Instagram Ads
  • Google Ads
  • Lead-generation campaigns
  • Conversion campaigns
  • Remarketing
  • Lookalike/custom audiences
  • Campaign budgeting
  • Creative testing
  • A/B testing
  • Cost-per-lead optimization

You should understand metrics such as:

CPL • CTR • CPC • CPM • Conversion Rate • ROAS • CAC

But more importantly, you should understand what action to take when those numbers aren't performing.

3. Analytics

Working knowledge of:

  • Meta Business Suite
  • Meta Ads Manager
  • Google Analytics / GA4
  • Google Search Console
  • YouTube Analytics
  • Google Trends
  • Pixel & conversion tracking
  • UTM tracking

We want someone who can turn data into decisions, not simply download reports.

4. Consumer Psychology

This is extremely important for us.

You should be curious about:

Why does someone click?

Why does someone watch one Reel for 3 seconds and another for 40 seconds?

Why does someone save a video but not enquire?

Why does one advertisement generate cheap but poor-quality leads while another generates fewer but serious customers?

Understanding attention, curiosity, trust, objections, desire and buying behaviour will be a major advantage.

Content Marketing

You don't necessarily have to shoot or edit every video.

But you should be able to guide the creative team on:

Topic Hook Content Angle Thumbnail CTA Distribution Retargeting

You should be comfortable telling the team:

“Video achha hai, but opening ke first 3 seconds weak hain. Let's test another hook.”

That's the mindset we're looking for.

Qualification

Degree is preferred. Skills are mandatory.

Bachelor's degree / Diploma in:

  • Digital Marketing
  • Marketing
  • Mass Communication
  • Business/Management
  • Media
  • Advertising

is an advantage, but not compulsory.

Candidates with strong practical knowledge and proven results are encouraged to apply even without a specialized degree.

Experience

1–3 years preferred.

Freshers can also apply if they have exceptional practical knowledge and can demonstrate their work.

Agency experience, personal projects, freelancing or managing your own successful social-media pages will also be considered.

Who We're Looking For

Someone who is:

Analytical + Creative + Curious + Result-Oriented

Someone who doesn't wait for instructions for everything.

If a campaign isn't working, you should naturally want to know:

“Why?”

If a Reel suddenly performs 10X better than usual:

“Why?”

If competitors are growing faster:

“What are they doing differently?”

That curiosity matters to us.

What We DON'T Want

Someone whose entire strategy is:

“Sir, 500 ka boost kar dete hain.”

We are looking for someone who understands the difference between boosting a post and building an actual marketing system.

How to Apply

Please send:

  1. CV
  2. Previous social-media pages/accounts managed
  3. Examples of Meta/Google campaigns you've handled
  4. Any measurable results you've achieved
  5. Tools you're comfortable using
  6. Current location
  7. Current/Last salary
  8. Expected salary

Work Location: Ranchi, Jharkhand

Our Goal

We aren't looking for someone simply to manage our social media.

We want someone who can help us understand our audience better, build authority through content, generate qualified enquiries and continuously improve results through experimentation and data.Role & responsibilities

jobDescription:
The Role

This is a full-cycle sales role. You will own everything from finding the right prospect to handing over a signed client - there is no SDR passing you leads, no pre-sales team doing the first call, and no account manager taking over after closure. You do it all, with demo support available when you need it.

You will be selling across three distinct product lines to three different buyer personas - HR leaders, finance and audit heads, and operations or project managers. The ability to switch context, speak the language of different decision-makers, and manage multiple pipelines simultaneously is central to this role.

What You Will Do

1. Database Generation & Prospecting

  • Build and maintain a structured prospect database across all three product lines and their respective buyer personas
  • Source contacts using LinkedIn, industry directories, CODISSIA / Chamber of Commerce member lists, trade publications, and local business networks
  • Segment database by product fit, company size, industry, and geography (CBE, Tirupur, Erode, and pan-Tamil Nadu as the business grows)
  • Maintain clean, updated records in CRM - every contact, every interaction, every follow-up logged

2. Cold Outreach & Lead Generation

  • Execute outbound outreach via phone calls, WhatsApp, LinkedIn, and email - targeting the right person with the right product message
  • Craft personalised outreach for each product and each buyer persona - the pitch to an HR Manager is fundamentally different from the pitch to a CFO
  • Handle gatekeepers, navigate to decision-makers, and earn the right to a conversation without being pushy
  • Consistently generate 40-60 qualified conversations per month across all product lines

3. Demo Scheduling & Coordination

  • Qualify prospects thoroughly before scheduling a demo - understand their pain, confirm decision-making authority, and set expectations
  • Coordinate with the internal demo support team to schedule and prepare tailored product demonstrations
  • Attend every demo as the relationship owner - your role during the demo is to read the room, handle objections in real time, and guide the conversation toward next steps
  • Brief the demo support team on the prospect's specific context and priorities before each session

4. Follow-Up,

  • Own the post-demo follow-up process - proposals, pricing discussions, handling objections, and pushing toward a decision
  • Navigate multi-stakeholder decisions where HR, Finance, and Operations may all have a say
  • Manage sales cycles ranging from 2 weeks (SMB, HR product) to 3 months (enterprise, audit tool) simultaneously
  • Close deals, coordinate onboarding handover to the delivery team, and maintain the relationship through the initial implementation period

5. Pipeline Management & Reporting

  • Maintain a live, accurate pipeline in CRM across all three products at all times
  • Report weekly to the founder on: leads generated, demos scheduled, proposals sent, deals closed, and blockers
  • Identify patterns - which products are gaining traction, which industries are responding, which buyer personas are hardest to reach - and share insights with the team
  • Set and track personal monthly targets for outreach volume, demo count, and revenue closure.

Job Description
Title: AI Marketing Research Associate
Experience: Fresher/Entry Level
Industry: IT Services
Duration: Paid | 12-week program | Part-time
Net Solutions is looking for an unusually sharp university student or recent graduate in the UK to work with our marketing team on research, content, AI-assisted workflows, and marketing operations. This is not a conventional marketing internship. We are looking for someone who can take an unfamiliar business question, research it properly, use AI intelligently, challenge what the AI produces, and turn the work into something useful. You do not need years of marketing experience. You do need to be a strong thinker, researcher, and communicator.


Responsibilities
  • Researching industries, companies, competitors, and market trends
  • Reviewing AI-generated articles and marketing copy for logic, accuracy, and weak arguments
  • Finding and verifying credible primary sources for claims and statistics
  • Researching prospects and target accounts for campaigns and events
  • Comparing competitor positioning, services, and go-to-market approaches
  • Supporting SEO and AI-search research
  • Helping turn research into useful content, campaign, and sales material
  • Testing ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and other AI tools against real marketing tasks
  • Developing repeatable AI-assisted processes that make our marketing team faster
  • Bringing a UK-market perspective to messaging, research, and campaigns
  • You will work on live Net Solutions initiatives rather than simulated internship projects.


Nice to have
  • Excellent written English
  • Strong research and analytical ability
  • An instinct for questioning information rather than simply accepting it
  • Excellent attention to detail
  • The ability to understand unfamiliar subjects quickly
  • Experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini
  • The ability to distinguish credible evidence from something that merely looks credible
  • Good judgment about what makes writing clear, useful, and believable
  • Curiosity about technology, AI, business, and marketing
  • The ability to work independently once the objective is clear
  • A marketing or technical degree is not required.
  • HOW WE THINK ABOUT AI
  • We expect you to use AI extensively.
  • We also expect you to recognize when it is wrong, generic, poorly reasoned, or unsupported.
  • If your approach is simply to ask ChatGPT to produce an answer and submit it, this role will not be a good fit.
  • The ability to challenge AI output matters more to us than knowing clever prompts.
  • WORKING ARRANGEMENT
  • This is a 12-week, part-time paid position, requiring approximately 1520 hours per week.
  • The role is UK-based and remote, and will involve working with members of the Net Solutions team in India. Some availability during UK mornings will therefore be important.
  • Hours can be arranged around university commitments.
  • COMPENSATION
  • 1620 per hour, depending on demonstrated ability and experience.


Collaboration
  • SELECTION PROCESS
  • 1. Application
  • Send us your CV or LinkedIn profile and, if possible, something that demonstrates how you think, research, or write.
  • 2. Paid practical assignment
  • Shortlisted candidates will receive a short exercise involving research, AI-generated content, fact checking, and judgment.
  • You may use any AI tools you want.
  • We are interested in both what you produce and how you got there.
  • 3. Conversation
  • A short discussion about your assignment, how you approached it, what you disagreed with, and what you would do differently.
  • Exceptional performers may be considered for future opportunities with Net Solutions.

jobDescription:
Sprinto is an Autonomous Trust Platform that centralizes trust requirements across security frameworks, vendors, and customers.

Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks.

Backed by top-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we ve raised $31.8M in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over 4,000 organizations across 75 countries, Sprinto helps organizations stay audit-ready, manage real-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With 300+ native integrations and AI-driven automation, Sprinto supports 200+ global security standards natively, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and more. Sprintos extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks.

Founded in 2020 by second-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more.

Life as a Sprinter -

Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane.

We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we dont wait for permission; we step in.

Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams arent built by sitting together, theyre built by pulling in the same direction.

We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching.

And while we move with urgency, we never move alone.

The mission -
We are seeking a Senior Account Executive (Enterprise) to drive growth by owning the full sales cycle - from prospecting and pipeline creation to closing high-value, multi-stakeholder deals. This is a role for a proven hunter and closer who thrives in competitive environments, engages C-level executives with confidence, and consistently delivers results. You ll be selling a category-defining solution, working with ambitious mid-market and growth-stage companies, and playing a key role in shaping our revenue engine.
Where youll leave your mark
  • Own and manage the end-to-end sales process for Enterprise accounts with an ACV of $50k to $250k
  • Prospect, qualify, and build a strong pipeline of new logos while expanding within existing customers.
  • Lead consultative, value-driven sales conversations with VP and C-level executives.
  • Build and execute territory plans to systematically open new opportunities.

  • Proven track record of meeting or exceeding annual new business quotas , with consistent high performance.
  • Strong communication, negotiation, discovery, and presentation skills, with the ability to engage CXO-level stakeholders and close complex deals.
How we care for our Sprinters
  • Work wherever you are: We are 100% remote, so you get to choose if you want to work from home, a cafe, the hills, or the beach.
